versions.changelog: Stronger rules for natural-language UX: agent never shows bash commands to users
Rewrote SKILL.md: natural-language UX for Telegram users, internal commands hidden

Initial release of fetch-agents: call and discover Fetch.ai Agentverse agents.

- Search the Agentverse marketplace for AI agents.
- Browse a curated catalog of top agents (e.g., ASI1-Mini, DALL-E 3, Technical Analysis).
- Send ChatMessages or tasks to any agent by name or address.
- Two-step call process to handle agent response times (30–60 seconds).
- Requires AGENTVERSE_API_KEY and Python 3.
- Catalog includes agent shortcuts for common use cases.
